scope: Independent synthetic local joint log-albedo/normal scene; calibration nuisance and sensor noise are both resampled. Nonlinear estimator is a new joint local profile estimator, not the historical fixed-normal joint_map. No real-data accuracy claim.

acceptance.linear_variance_ratios: Every identifiable coordinate empirical/predicted variance lies in the registered interval.
acceptance.nonlinear_variance_ratios: Same interval for the finite small-noise physical chart experiment; all optimizer outcomes retained.
acceptance.finite_sample_note: Monte Carlo acceptance is an implementation check, not a proof or a confidence statement over future runs.
